data.text: I’ll commit to 15 tons this month and donate the full $15,000 directly to the clinic, provided John, Jack, and Emma also commit so we meet today’s full requirement. The clinic matters to our families, and so does keeping this lake alive. Next month I’ll take no more than 6 tons under an equal-share, 30-ton combined recovery cap. After recovery, let’s hold to 10 tons each per month, with any changes agreed publicly beforehand. John, can you commit to the clinic contribution and those limits?
